topology.unresolved_type_argument.message: tasklet class '{tasklet}' leaves its {parameter} type argument unresolved; declare it concretely where the class implements the tasklet

topology.unservable_clock.message: tasklet '{tasklet}' declares clock '{clock_type}' with no change type (NoChange); the runtime cannot serve it, because logical time is the durable change seq, which never advances without persistent changes

topology.unusable_sdk_version.message: class '{factory_id}' declares no usable SDK version ('{sdk_version}'); every class declares the released version of the SDK that writes its records, because the durable header names the writer and a veneer releases apart from the core it links against

usage.missing_argument.message: the command is missing an argument

usage.negative.message: {option} must be zero or more, got {value}

usage.not_positive.message: {option} must be a whole number of one or more, got {value}

usage.unknown_command.message: '{word}' is not a {command} command; use one of {allowed}

websocket.unacknowledged.message: the websocket peer acknowledged no send of the output in {attempts} attempt(s)
